name: program-runtime.fleet-fanout
purpose: Read two runtime measures and scoped binding conditions concurrently, returning counts and bounded field-name summaries.
assumptions: agent-manager, ai-gateway, and program-runtime are running
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
no row set is materialized; every reading is count or head(1)
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
each surface exposes at most 10 printable ASCII field-name summaries of at most 40 characters, with truncation explicit

signals.surfaces: agent_manager_runs, ai_gateway_calls, and program_runtime_conditions -> {count, first_row_keys, keys_truncated}, or {unavailable: true}
